paragraphs.source_en: Lady Nō held her blade ready, guarding Nobunaga as he considered whether to advance or withdraw. Frowning, Nobunaga looked toward the place where Mori Ranmaru had disappeared, glanced at the bodies of friend and foe strewn around him, and steadied his breathing.

paragraphs.source_en: In the past, whenever Nobunaga stood among courtiers, tea masters, and Western missionaries, he had always seemed to tower above them, a man who did not belong in their company. But now, standing there with a blood-soaked sickle-spear in his hands, Oda Nobunaga had become wholly one with the warriors' struggle. The hero had found a field worthy of his prowess; at last, the champion of a turbulent age stood where he belonged.

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga was, after all, a warrior... No, the lady thought, shaking her head with a sigh: Nobunaga had been born to range unfettered through an age of war, and under no circumstances would he admit defeat. That was precisely why, throughout his life, he had continued to perform astonishing deeds that left the world agape.

paragraphs.source_en: Yet the lady also reflected that a hero of turbulent times was not necessarily a hero in an age of peace. It was the same with her: she could be the wife of the young and ruthless Oda Nobunaga, but she could not become the wife of the Minister of the Right. At that moment, she longed to know what emotions truly filled Nobunaga's heart after all the dizzying rises and falls he had endured.

paragraphs.source_en: Oda Nobunaga, whose habitual refrain was “A human life lasts but fifty years,” now faced the fate of leaving his corpse in the wilderness at only forty-nine. However heroic one might call it, the prospect was pitiful—and more pitiful still if his body were hacked to pieces.

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长计算着自己和虎松的距离，已经来不及救了，就停在那里没有动。何时前进何时后退，这头猛兽已经把握了其中的尺度，甚至精准到令人惊骇的程度。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not act so recklessly, you fool!”

units.source_en: “Do not act so recklessly, you fool!”
units.source_zh: “休要任性，你这个傻瓜！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “休要任性，你这个傻瓜！”

paragraphs.source_en: The lady rose and slowly lifted her great naginata.

units.source_en: The lady rose and slowly lifted her great naginata.
units.source_zh: 夫人站了起来，慢慢地提起大薙刀。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, a fresh wave of enemies charged through the middle gate. “Where is the General of the Right?” One man among the surging enemy ranks shouted, “Miyake Magojūrō, retainer of the Akechi, has come to claim the seal! Where is the General of the Right?”

units.source_en: At that moment, a fresh wave of enemies charged through the middle gate.
units.source_zh: 这时，新来的敌人又杀进了中门。

units.source_en: “Where is the General of the Right?”

units.source_en: One man among the surging enemy ranks shouted, “Miyake Magojūrō, retainer of the Akechi, has come to claim the seal! Where is the General of the Right?”
units.source_zh: 汹涌而来的敌人中，一人大声喊道，“明智家臣三宅孙十郎前来索要玉玺，右大将在哪里？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 这时，新来的敌人又杀进了中门。“右大将在哪里？”汹涌而来的敌人中，一人大声喊道，“明智家臣三宅孙十郎前来索要玉玺，右大将在哪里？”

paragraphs.source_en: At the very front, a man with pink cords fastened to his armor came running toward the lady. A scream rose from below the steps. But it was immediately drowned beneath the booming shout of a black-armored warrior following behind. The warrior's voice rang like the roar of a lion: “Hear me, Lord Nobunaga, General of the Right! I am the renowned Yasuda Sakubē of the Akechi army.”

units.source_en: At the very front, a man with pink cords fastened to his armor came running toward the lady.
units.source_zh: 最前面，一个盔甲上系着粉红色丝绦的人朝夫人这边跑来。

units.source_en: A scream rose from below the steps.
units.source_zh: 台阶下面传来一阵惨叫。

units.source_en: The warrior's voice rang like the roar of a lion: “Hear me, Lord Nobunaga, General of the Right! I am the renowned Yasuda Sakubē of the Akechi army.”
units.source_zh: 那名武士的声音像怒吼的狮子：“右大将信长公听着，我乃明智军中鼎鼎有名的安田作兵卫。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 最前面，一个盔甲上系着粉红色丝绦的人朝夫人这边跑来。台阶下面传来一阵惨叫。但紧接着，就被随后而来的黑甲武士洪亮的喊声淹没了。那名武士的声音像怒吼的狮子：“右大将信长公听着，我乃明智军中鼎鼎有名的安田作兵卫。”

paragraphs.source_en: Now was the time to die! The thought swept through the lady's heart like a gale. She raised her blade and leaped out as though possessed. The man wearing the pink cords hurriedly stepped back. The instant the lady's toes touched the ground, she suddenly slashed to the right. Her opponent's spear and head flew through the air amid a rain of blood, and the man toppled backward. The lady then attacked Sakubē.

units.source_en: Now was the time to die!
units.source_zh: 现在才是赴死之时！

units.source_en: The thought swept through the lady's heart like a gale. She raised her blade and leaped out as though possessed.
units.source_zh: 这种感慨像疾风一样掠过夫人的心头，她举起刀，发疯似的跳了出去。

units.source_en: The man wearing the pink cords hurriedly stepped back.
units.source_zh: 扎粉红色丝绦之人慌忙后退一步。

units.source_en: The instant the lady's toes touched the ground, she suddenly slashed to the right. Her opponent's spear and head flew through the air amid a rain of blood, and the man toppled backward.
units.source_zh: 夫人脚尖刚一落地，就突然向右砍了一刀，对方的枪和脑袋都飞了起来，漫天血雨，那人仰天倒下。

units.source_en: The lady then attacked Sakubē.
units.source_zh: 夫人又再次攻向作兵卫。

paragraphs.source_zh: 现在才是赴死之时！这种感慨像疾风一样掠过夫人的心头，她举起刀，发疯似的跳了出去。扎粉红色丝绦之人慌忙后退一步。夫人脚尖刚一落地，就突然向右砍了一刀，对方的枪和脑袋都飞了起来，漫天血雨，那人仰天倒下。夫人又再次攻向作兵卫。

paragraphs.source_en: “A woman? Have you no regard for your life?” Sakubē backed away two steps with his spear in hand, grinding his teeth in fury. “Useless woman—stand aside!”

units.source_en: “A woman?
units.source_zh: “女人？

units.source_en: Have you no regard for your life?”
units.source_zh: 真是不要命了！”

units.source_en: Sakubē backed away two steps with his spear in hand, grinding his teeth in fury. “Useless woman—stand aside!”
units.source_zh: 作兵卫拿着枪，后退了两步，气得咬牙切齿，“无用的女人，还不退下！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “女人？真是不要命了！”作兵卫拿着枪，后退了两步，气得咬牙切齿，“无用的女人，还不退下！”

paragraphs.source_en: The lady gave a mocking laugh and pressed one step closer. During that interval, Nobunaga had ample time to withdraw inside.

units.source_en: The lady gave a mocking laugh and pressed one step closer.
units.source_zh: 夫人嘲笑着，又向前逼了一步。

units.source_en: During that interval, Nobunaga had ample time to withdraw inside.
units.source_zh: 在这段时间里，信长完全可以退到里面。

paragraphs.source_zh: 夫人嘲笑着，又向前逼了一步。在这段时间里，信长完全可以退到里面。

paragraphs.source_en: Realizing that the woman neither intended to retreat nor feared him, Sakubē pushed back the armor at his shoulder and swung his long spear into position. The lady moved another step closer. Sakubē flicked his spear forward in a thrust just as the lady swept her naginata in a great arc. With a clang, the two weapons collided.

units.source_en: Realizing that the woman neither intended to retreat nor feared him, Sakubē pushed back the armor at his shoulder and swung his long spear into position.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫发现女人既没有要后退之意，也不会害怕自己，把肩膀上的护甲往后拨了拨，抡起长枪。

units.source_en: The lady moved another step closer.
units.source_zh: 夫人又逼近一步。

units.source_en: Sakubē flicked his spear forward in a thrust just as the lady swept her naginata in a great arc. With a clang, the two weapons collided.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫抖枪就刺，正好夫人也抡圆了薙刀，“哐”的一声，兵器碰到了一起。

paragraphs.source_zh: 作兵卫发现女人既没有要后退之意，也不会害怕自己，把肩膀上的护甲往后拨了拨，抡起长枪。夫人又逼近一步。作兵卫抖枪就刺，正好夫人也抡圆了薙刀，“哐”的一声，兵器碰到了一起。

paragraphs.source_en: Then came a scraping sound, as though the point of the naginata had struck the black leather of the armor. The lady swayed. She felt as if a piece of red-hot iron had been driven from her lower belly through to her back. A burning warmth spread within her; the foot she was about to advance suddenly gave way, and she sank to her knees.

units.source_en: Then came a scraping sound, as though the point of the naginata had struck the black leather of the armor.
units.source_zh: 接着，咯吱一声，似乎是薙刀的刀尖碰到了护甲的黑皮。

units.source_en: The lady swayed. She felt as if a piece of red-hot iron had been driven from her lower belly through to her back. A burning warmth spread within her; the foot she was about to advance suddenly gave way, and she sank to her knees.
units.source_zh: 夫人摇晃起来，她只觉得从下腹部到后背像被扎进了一块热铁，热乎乎的，正要迈出的脚立刻软了下来，跪在了地上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 接着，咯吱一声，似乎是薙刀的刀尖碰到了护甲的黑皮。夫人摇晃起来，她只觉得从下腹部到后背像被扎进了一块热铁，热乎乎的，正要迈出的脚立刻软了下来，跪在了地上。

paragraphs.source_en: Even so, the lady tried to rise and wield her blade. But she could not move and could only fall forward onto the grass. The scent of green grass filled her nostrils. Raising her head, the lady saw the carpet of grass as an emerald surface of water, with the scattered bodies of both armies lying upon it like water lilies afloat.

units.source_en: Even so, the lady tried to rise and wield her blade.
units.source_zh: 尽管如此，夫人仍然想站起来，挥舞刀。

units.source_en: But she could not move and could only fall forward onto the grass.
units.source_zh: 可是她动弹不得，只得趴在了草地上。

units.source_en: The scent of green grass filled her nostrils. Raising her head, the lady saw the carpet of grass as an emerald surface of water, with the scattered bodies of both armies lying upon it like water lilies afloat.
units.source_zh: 青草的气味扑鼻而来，夫人抬起头，只见一地绿草就像碧绿的水面，零零落落倒伏在地上的双方尸体，就像漂浮在水面的睡莲。

paragraphs.source_zh: 尽管如此，夫人仍然想站起来，挥舞刀。可是她动弹不得，只得趴在了草地上。青草的气味扑鼻而来，夫人抬起头，只见一地绿草就像碧绿的水面，零零落落倒伏在地上的双方尸体，就像漂浮在水面的睡莲。

paragraphs.source_en: It seemed to be Mori Ranmaru. The lady strained to lift her head and saw a warrior standing on the railing to the right, about to thrust Sakubē down from it.

units.source_en: It seemed to be Mori Ranmaru.
units.source_zh: 似是森兰丸。

units.source_en: The lady strained to lift her head and saw a warrior standing on the railing to the right, about to thrust Sakubē down from it.
units.source_zh: 夫人拼命抬起头来，只见一名武士站在右面的栏杆上，正要把作兵卫推下去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 似是森兰丸。夫人拼命抬起头来，只见一名武士站在右面的栏杆上，正要把作兵卫推下去。

paragraphs.source_en: Bracing himself with his spear, Sakubē nimbly leaped to Nobunaga's side. “I am Yasuda Sakubē. Hand over the seal!”

units.source_en: Bracing himself with his spear, Sakubē nimbly leaped to Nobunaga's side.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫用枪一撑，敏捷地跳到了信长身边。

units.source_en: “I am Yasuda Sakubē. Hand over the seal!”
units.source_zh: “我乃安田作兵卫，请交出玉玺！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 作兵卫用枪一撑，敏捷地跳到了信长身边。“我乃安田作兵卫，请交出玉玺！”

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga still stood haughtily with his weight upon his spear, dressed in an unlined robe of white silk and bound with a white sash. His proud, heroic bearing struck awe into all who saw him.

units.source_en: Nobunaga still stood haughtily with his weight upon his spear, dressed in an unlined robe of white silk and bound with a white sash. His proud, heroic bearing struck awe into all who saw him.
units.source_zh: 信长依然傲慢地拄枪屹立，身穿白绫单衣，扎着白色丝带，雄姿傲然，令人望而生畏。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长依然傲慢地拄枪屹立，身穿白绫单衣，扎着白色丝带，雄姿傲然，令人望而生畏。

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly, a figure sprang from behind the immovable Nobunaga and thrust a spear straight at Sakubē. “Sakubē, do you still recognize me, Mori Ranmaru?”

units.source_en: Suddenly, a figure sprang from behind the immovable Nobunaga and thrust a spear straight at Sakubē.
units.source_zh: 突然，从稳如泰山的信长背后蹿出一条人影，对着作兵卫就是一枪。

units.source_en: “Sakubē, do you still recognize me, Mori Ranmaru?”
units.source_zh: “作兵卫，你还认识我森兰丸吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 突然，从稳如泰山的信长背后蹿出一条人影，对着作兵卫就是一枪。“作兵卫，你还认识我森兰丸吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: What astonishing fighting spirit! He could not be killed, could not be felled, and never seemed to tire. Mori Ranmaru's eighteen-year-old body had absorbed all of Nobunaga's courage and grown into a fearless man of iron.

units.source_en: What astonishing fighting spirit!
units.source_zh: 多么惊人的斗志啊！

units.source_en: He could not be killed, could not be felled, and never seemed to tire. Mori Ranmaru's eighteen-year-old body had absorbed all of Nobunaga's courage and grown into a fearless man of iron.
units.source_zh: 杀不死，打不倒，永远不知疲倦，森兰丸十八岁的身体吸收了信长的所有勇气，已经成长为一个无所畏惧的铁人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 多么惊人的斗志啊！杀不死，打不倒，永远不知疲倦，森兰丸十八岁的身体吸收了信长的所有勇气，已经成长为一个无所畏惧的铁人。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, Nobunaga, who had been gazing fixedly at Lady Nō, abruptly turned and walked inside. Lamplight shone upon the paper windows, making them gleam white.

units.source_en: At that moment, Nobunaga, who had been gazing fixedly at Lady Nō, abruptly turned and walked inside.
units.source_zh: 此时，一直凝视着浓夫人的信长，倏地转过身，向里面走去。

units.source_en: Lamplight shone upon the paper windows, making them gleam white.
units.source_zh: 窗户纸上映着灯光，闪着白色的光芒。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，一直凝视着浓夫人的信长，倏地转过身，向里面走去。窗户纸上映着灯光，闪着白色的光芒。

paragraphs.source_en: “General of the Right, come back!” Sakubē pursued Nobunaga.

units.source_en: “General of the Right, come back!”
units.source_zh: “右大将，你回来！”

units.source_en: Sakubē pursued Nobunaga.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫追赶着信长。

paragraphs.source_zh: “右大将，你回来！”作兵卫追赶着信长。

paragraphs.source_en: But Nobunaga did not look back and continued walking inward. This was the last glimpse the world would have of the peerless hero's retreating figure. Even one possessed of strength enough to uproot mountains and lift great cauldrons, when treachery erupted at his very elbow and troops hemmed him in on every side, could do nothing but die a heroic death.

units.source_en: But Nobunaga did not look back and continued walking inward.
units.source_zh: 可是，信长却头也不回，一直往里走去。

units.source_en: This was the last glimpse the world would have of the peerless hero's retreating figure.
units.source_zh: 这便是盖世英雄留给人间的最后一个背影。

units.source_en: Even one possessed of strength enough to uproot mountains and lift great cauldrons, when treachery erupted at his very elbow and troops hemmed him in on every side, could do nothing but die a heroic death.
units.source_zh: 饶是身具拔山扛鼎之力，变生肘腋，面对团团之兵，亦唯有壮烈一死。

paragraphs.source_zh: 可是，信长却头也不回，一直往里走去。这便是盖世英雄留给人间的最后一个背影。饶是身具拔山扛鼎之力，变生肘腋，面对团团之兵，亦唯有壮烈一死。

paragraphs.source_en: Sakubē approached the window and thrust his spear inside. At that instant, the disheveled Mori Ranmaru attacked Sakubē once more. Startled, Sakubē turned again to confront Mori Ranmaru before him.

units.source_en: Sakubē approached the window and thrust his spear inside.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫靠近窗边，往里捅了一枪。

units.source_en: At that instant, the disheveled Mori Ranmaru attacked Sakubē once more.
units.source_zh: 此时，披头散发的森兰丸又向作兵卫袭来。

units.source_en: Startled, Sakubē turned again to confront Mori Ranmaru before him.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫吃了一惊，再次转身对付眼前的森兰丸。

paragraphs.source_zh: 作兵卫靠近窗边，往里捅了一枪。此时，披头散发的森兰丸又向作兵卫袭来。作兵卫吃了一惊，再次转身对付眼前的森兰丸。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord!” Mori Ranmaru called inside, “Not one enemy will advance another step. Set your mind at ease!”

units.source_en: “My lord!”
units.source_zh: “主公！”

units.source_en: Mori Ranmaru called inside, “Not one enemy will advance another step. Set your mind at ease!”
units.source_zh: 森兰丸朝里面喊道，“敌人一步也近前不了，您放心！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公！”森兰丸朝里面喊道，“敌人一步也近前不了，您放心！”
